# Rowla repository instructions

Read and apply [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before code changes.
It is the canonical guide for architecture, commands, native invariants, and evidence.
Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow.

This is a native Rust/AppKit app for macOS 15.2+, with a portable library test subset on Linux.
Use the pinned Rust toolchain and locked dependencies. Keep changes focused and preserve other contributors' work.
Report actual checks and native limits. AI-assisted contributions are welcome and receive the same review as other contributions.
